# discord_server_role_permissions (Data Source)

Reads the server-level permissions a role grants together with `@everyone`, as Discord computes them. Other roles are not included. See [Get Guild Role Permissions](https://docs.discord.com/developers/resources/guild#get-guild-role-permissions).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_role" "moderators" {
  server_id = var.server_id
  name      = "Moderators"
}

# What the role grants across the server, together with @everyone.
data "discord_server_role_permissions" "moderators" {
  server_id = var.server_id
  role_id   = data.discord_role.moderators.id
}

output "moderator_permissions" {
  value = data.discord_server_role_permissions.moderators.permission_names
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role_id` (String) ID of the role.
- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).

### Read-Only

- `permission_names` (Set of String) Names of the permission flags set in `permissions`, such as `VIEW_CHANNEL`. Flags this provider does not know are omitted.
- `permissions` (String) The computed permissions as a decimal bitfield string.
